title: Day 6/100 of letting AI trade $10,000
author: Newrateacc
selftext:
Portfolio: $11,024.28

Today: up $80.87 (up 0.74%). Good to see a big Green Day when SPY is down.

FAANG+ Momentum, $2,563.02, up $75.36 (up 3.03%), best mover by a wide margin. It sold out of AAPL and NVDA entirely on the daily rerank, trimmed META down rather than exiting it, and opened a fresh NFLX position that is now its single biggest holding. Still holding META, just less of it.

Worst mover, and the only real loser: High Profile Congress, $479.50, down $13.24 (down 2.69%). It sold PG and bought FSLR off a fresh disclosure this morning, but the swap did not help today, this one is down two days running now.

Crypto Rotator, $228.61, up $7.17 (up 3.24%), clawed back some of Tuesday's AVAX drawdown.

AI Picks & Shovels, $1,048.17, up $5.18 (up 0.50%). Sold AMD and some NVDA, added ANET back and more SMCI.

One to watch: First of the Month sold SPY and bought UPRO right at the close today, that is the turn of month leverage window starting, so expect bigger swings out of this one for the next several sessions either direction.

Everything else, Pelosi Tracker, FDA Inspector, Founder Mode, Hot Hand, Trump Tweet Trader, Business As Usual, moved single digit dollars either way, quiet by comparison.

Six days in: up, flat, up big, flat, down, up. First real green day after a red one, which is the whole point of posting both kinds.

comments.author: Key_Attitude_4708
comments.body: Six days obviously proves nothing yet but beating a red SPY day while the strategies are actually rotating holdings is more interesting than an AI portfolio that just sits in megacap tech. The UPRO switch is where the next few sessions could get spicy. Moon could be a fun separate way to test the same directional calls, just keeping in mind it is a price wager rather than a portfolio.
